description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

Your intellect has pierced through the facade o existence and seen that its all meaningless; life, death, pleasure, pain, hope, despair... Sure, you wake up every morning and go through the motions of what you call life, because why not, but your Ambitions only provide a :uarter o the XP they ordinarily would. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.8pVzgPkgWpTJvfhG]{Fearless} (All) Talent and Painless Creature Trait as your body and mind turn indierent towards threats and punishment. Your ambitions tend towards nihilism, involving things that, at least to you, con rm or challenge the pointlessness of existence; like randomly killing a number of people, letting the dice make your decisions or giving away all your wealth. Your lack of emotions and indierence cause discomfort in others and you gain -10 Fellowship. You can only gain this mutation once.
